title: RAG-Driver: Generalisable Driving Explanations with Retrieval-Augmented In-Context Learning in Multi-Modal Large Language Model
layout_note: A central row of tokens split into two dashed blocks ('Current Input' and 'Retrieved Input'); above it, the retrieval loop (Linear Projection -> s^q -> query -> database -> down into the retrieved block); below it, a stack of full-width bars (projections / text encoder, Large Language Model, Text De-Tokenizer) ending in the output sentence.
grouping: Dashed rounded frames group each token block (current input, retrieved input, the s^q query tokens), the Retrieval Engine (database cylinder), a notation box at top-left, the output sentence and a legend at bottom-left; modules are not framed, only filled bars.
shapes_depth: Flat pastel rounded rectangles (pink or green) for modules, small rounded squares for tokens (the s^q tokens have a grey drop shadow), a white outlined cylinder for the database, black fire and snowflake icons at the right end of each module; no 3-D.
proposed_highlight: The retrieval part gets its own dashed frame with a database cylinder at top-right, and the retrieved tokens get a second dashed block labelled 'Retrieved Input' beside the 'Current Input' block; trainable modules are pink with a fire icon, frozen ones green with a snowflake.
lesson: Draw retrieved in-context examples as tokens in the same row as the current input, in a second dashed block beside it whose token order mirrors the first, so retrieval reads as extending the model's input sequence.
notes: Venue written as arXiv: the arXiv v3 first page states no venue; remembered venue RSS 2024 (unverified). year = arXiv preprint year. refs crop found no 'Figure 2' caption (the PDF writes 'Fig. 2:'), so the figure was cropped from page 4 by hand at the embedded image's box; the whole figure is one raster image, and images_px in the crop record was narrowed to the stacked video-frame photos so the palette measures the diagram.

taxonomy.task: explaining and justifying driving actions and predicting control signals from video, with retrieved driving examples as in-context samples

insights.structure: Everything hangs off one horizontal token row in the middle: the retrieval loop sits above it, the projection / encoder / LLM / de-tokenizer stack below it, the video input and the legend to its left.
insights.data: Video frames are a stack of three real night-time photos, tokens are small rounded squares coloured by type (video, control signal, instruction, action) and keyed in a dashed legend, and the output is a quoted sentence split by grey braces into 'Action & Justification' and 'Next Control Signal'.
insights.emphasis: The retrieval engine is the only element with a database glyph and its own large dashed frame at top-right, and the retrieved tokens get their own labelled block in the token row.
insights.flow: The query path runs as a rectangle - up from the current tokens through Linear Projection to s^q, right along a 'query' arrow into the cylinder, down into the retrieved block - and the generation path then runs straight down through three full-width bars to the output sentence.
insights.avoid: Trainability is coded twice (pink/green fill and fire/snowflake icon), while the retrieved tokens use the same colours as the current ones and are told apart only by a dashed frame and a small label.

arrangement.units: one unframed diagram; dashed rounded frames mark the two token blocks, the s^q tokens, the retrieval engine, the notation box, the output sentence and the legend
arrangement.inputs_as: a stack of three real dash-cam frames labelled 'Video Frames', entering a tall green Video Encoder bar
arrangement.shared: the MLP Projection is drawn twice (pink, fire icon), one under each end of the token row for current and retrieved video tokens; one Text Encoder bar spans the middle of both blocks

core.what: a database cylinder in a dashed 'Retrieval Engine' frame at top-right is queried by the projected s^q tokens and returns c^icl and z^icl, which drop straight down into a 'Retrieved Input' token block placed in the same row as the 'Current Input' block

relations.form: the store beside the main row (top-right), its two outputs drawn as arrows down into a second dashed token block next to the current one, with token order mirrored (z_vo, c, z_t | z_t^icl, c^icl, z_vo^icl)
token row -> projections and text encoder -> full-width Large Language Model bar -> full-width Text De-Tokenizer bar -> quoted output sentence, straight down
three branches under the token row (left MLP Projection, middle Text Encoder, right MLP Projection) each send one arrow down into the single full-width LLM bar
the MLP Projection drawn as two identical pink boxes under the two ends of the token row, and one Text Encoder bar spanning both blocks' text tokens

channels.colour: two meanings, separated by shape: on token squares fill = token type (blue video, purple control signal, yellow task instruction, grey action/justification), keyed in the legend; on module bars fill = trainability (pink trainable, green frozen), repeated by fire/snowflake icons
channels.shape: small rounded squares = tokens, wide rounded bars = modules, cylinder = retrieval database, photo stack = video input, fire / snowflake icon = trainable / frozen
channels.line: one style only: solid black arrows = data flow; grey braces under the output mark its two parts
channels.frame: dashed rounded frame = one group (a token block, the s^q tokens, the retrieval engine, the notation box, the output, the legend)

quality.strengths: the retrieved examples are drawn as data in the same token row as the current input, in a mirrored dashed block, so what retrieval adds is visible as geometry; the query path is a clean rectangle of straight arrows (up to s^q, right to the cylinder, down to the row); token types are keyed once in a legend; the output is a real sentence with braces separating explanation from control signal
quality.weaknesses: retrieved tokens share the current tokens' colours and differ only by the dashed frame and a small 'Retrieved Input' label; trainability is coded on two channels (fill and icon); the top-left notation box (c^q, c^icl as c1..ck) is unconnected to anything; the 'Retrieval Engine' label crowds the cylinder; the Linear Projection that makes the query is as large as the LLM-side modules although it only serves retrieval

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)
